GROUPS PROTEST AFTER SENATE COUP, BATO RETURN

Civil society groups gather in an indignation rally in Pasay City on Wednesday, days after a Senate ouster which saw the election of Senate President Alan Peter Cayetano, and the return of Sen. Ronald "Bato" dela Rosa after months of absence.

The Senate has likewise placed dela Rosa under its protective custody after the International Criminal Court publicized its arrest warrant against him.

📷 The STAR / Edd Gumban

WARSHIP WEDNESDAYS | BRP Antonio Luna (FFG15)

BRP Antonio Luna (FFG15), the second Jose Rizal-class frigate of the Philippine Navy, was commissioned on March 19, 2021. Equipped with advanced missile, torpedo, and combat systems, the frigate is capable of Anti-Air, Anti-Surface, Anti-Submarine, and Electronic Warfare operations.

The vessel represented the Philippines during Rim of the Pacific Exercise 2022 in Hawaii, securing 3rd place in the Naval Surface Fire Support Rodeo.

On April 28, 2026, BRP Antonio Luna successfully conducted a Replenishment at Sea – Liquid Transfer (RAS-L) with MV Asterix during Exercise Balikatan 41-2026 off Capones Island, demonstrating operational readiness and interoperability in multinational maritime operations.

data.raw_text:
A few nice images of the 81 mm Scorpion mortar system in use with US Army's 25th Infantry Div during Exercise Balikatan in the Philippines. 

They're mounted on the sort of new Infantry Squad Vehicle, and can fire eight rounds and relocate within 2 minutes. 

A total of 72 rounds can be carried by each vehicle, so they should be able to support a few requests for fire. 

Maybe one day, if they're lucky, the British Army will get something similar.
